clauses.title: Security deposit refund
clauses.text: Security deposit shall be refunded within 30 days after vacating, subject only to legitimate deductions supported by evidence.

clauses.title: Normal wear and tear
clauses.text: Normal wear and tear, including minor paint fading, small nail holes, and ordinary flooring wear, shall not be charged to the tenant.

clauses.title: Deductions for actual damage
clauses.text: Landlord may deduct amounts only for actual damage beyond normal wear and tear.

clauses.title: Evidence for deductions
clauses.text: Every deduction must be supported by invoices, repair receipts, photographs, or quotations.

clauses.title: Cleaning charges
clauses.text: Cleaning charges may be deducted only if the premises are left in an unusually unhygienic condition.

clauses.title: Key return
clauses.text: Tenant shall return all keys before final inspection.

clauses.title: Utility bills responsibility
clauses.text: Utility bills up to move-out remain the tenant's responsibility.
